text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Quick sort recurses on the subproblems to the left and right of each locked pivot.
Theta(n log n) average time; Theta(n^2) worst case if pivot is unbalanced. In-place, non-stable.

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Recursion divides subproblems around each locked pivot until all elements are in place.
